messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 Canary error surge detected on /v1/chat for model 'redwood-beta-canary'. Error rate jump at 2026-03-20T14:12:01Z. Symptoms: HTTP 502/504, "token decode failed", and occasional OOM logs. Link: https://redwood.internal/alert/1916004321

oncall-liam: ack. paging infra and eng. tagging @infra-nina @eng-sophia. taking lead until handoff.

infra-nina: I see memory growth on canary pods after the new allocator change. Heap climbs until OOM kill. Rolling pods show container restarts ~1/min.

eng-sophia: I merged an allocator tweak to improve batch parallelism at 14:10:18. It touched the memory cap heuristics and tokenizer buffer sizing. Can reproduce locally with long prompt sequences.

deploybot: Deploy 2026-03-20T14:10:18 by eng-sophia -> canary: success. Auto-rollback job kicked at 14:14:02 but returned status: FAILED (artifact digest mismatch). See task log: https://redwood.internal/deploy/2026-03-20/5467

platform-omar: Automated rollback failing on digest mismatch is concerning. We should stop auto retrying to avoid noise, and perform manual traffic control. Suggest: disable canary-routing flag and shift traffic to stable. Anyone object?

eng-tony: no objection. Also recommend we scale canary replicas to 0 to prevent further requests landing there while we assess.

oncall-liam: doing flag toggle now.

platform-omar: running:
```bash
rwctl feature set canary_routing false --env=prod --by=oncall-liam
rwctl rollout traffic --service=inference --target=redwood-beta-stable --percent=100 --confirm
```

oncall-liam: flag set and traffic shift started at 14:18:04Z. Observability: request volume to canary dropping.

eng-sophia: confirmed the allocator change can produce zero-length token buffers when combined with a rare tokenizer edgecase (bad length hint from pre-tokenizer). That leads to "token decode failed" downstream. Reverting the allocator tweak is the right fix, but we'll need a tested patch.

infra-nina: scaling canary to zero now and restarting stable pods to warm caches:
```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/redwood-beta-canary --replicas=0
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/redwood-beta-stable
```

oncall-liam: scaled canary -> 0 at 14:19:30Z. Stable restart kicked at 14:20:05Z.

cs-lucy: CS note: ticket queue shows multiple customer-facing 502s from partners (streaming customers and a few early-adopter accounts). I've messaged impacted customers and set expectation: mitigating by shifting traffic; will update when fully recovered.

eng-tony: automation note: auto-rollback tool should probably mark digest-mismatch as "retryable but manual approval required" and not attempt blind reapply. Filing a follow-up.

deploybot: rollback automation logs (excerpt):
```
ERROR rollback: model-tag redwood-beta-canary@v2 digest mismatch (expected sha256:aa11..., observed sha256:bb22...) -> abort
INFO rollback: aborting to avoid inconsistent model artifacts
```

oncall-liam: smoke test after shift:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-beta-stable","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Write a haiku about clouds"}] }' | jq .
```
observed: 200 OK and valid response. Latency at 14:22 ~ baseline. :white_check_mark:

infra-nina: monitoring shows error rate back near baseline and no new OOMs after canary scaled to 0. I'll keep the canary drained until eng patch is validated in a non-prod environment.

eng-sophia: ownership: I'll revert allocator change, add a tokenizer length-hint assertion, and add an integration test with long continuous inputs to catch regression. ETA for PR: today EOD.

eng-tony: I'll own the automation change for rollback tool to handle digest mismatches gracefully. PR coming tomorrow.

cs-lucy: Customer update sent: "We've reverted canary routing and are observing normal service. We'll follow up with root cause and remediation timeline."

oncall-liam: handing monitoring to @oncall-rita for 45min watch window. Adding incident ticket and notes.

oncall-rita: ack taking watch. Please add runbook links and incident ticket.

oncall-liam: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollbacks. Incident ticket: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1916004321. Logs group: gcs://prod/logs/inference/canary/1916004321.

eng-sophia: postmortem owner: eng-sophia. Tags: regression, allocator, tokenizer, auto-rollback.

infra-nina: lowering immediate severity from P1 to P2 after 30m stable window. Will escalate if any relapse.

deploybot: automated job to disable further retries of rollback triggered by platform-omar at 14:25:10Z.

cs-lucy: I'll follow up with affected customers about timeline for permanent fix and offer credit where appropriate.

oncall-rita: all set on my end. Leaving notes in the ticket and locking canary to prevent new canaries until postmortem complete.

eng-tony: summary action items: revert allocator tweak (eng-sophia), add tokenizer assertion & test (eng-sophia), fix rollback tool retry semantics (eng-tony), customer comms (cs-lucy), keep canary scaled=0 until verified (infra-nina).

incident-bot: Incident mitigated: traffic returned to stable; canary drained. Monitoring window started 14:19:30Z.

oncall-rita: last check 14:30Z: metrics steady. handing back to oncall-liam for any follow-up tomorrow.

eng-sophia: thanks all. I'll include reproduction steps in the postmortem and link PRs once ready. :memo:
